why_this_domain: Shares no gene identifiers, no annotation database and no curation with the gene-set machinery. A set is a pile of intervals and its size is a property of antibody, depth and peak caller.
substrate: NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog (GRCh38) x ChIP-Atlas hg38 peak calls at q < 1e-05

construction.query_rule: MAPPED_TRAIT with the most associations at p < 5e-08; deterministic and capability-blind
construction.set_rule: hg38 'TFs and others' experiments in the cell-type class with the most such experiments, sorted by ID, first 300
construction.tissue_matching: NONE. Trait and cell-type class are selected by independent rules; this is not a biological claim about either.

scope: No experiment, antigen or publication is named as a finding.
